catalog.policy: Keep meaningful implementations and vocabularies with useful results; remove smoke/fold/resume/epoch duplicates and marginal variants.
catalog.limitations: Different vocabularies/splits are not directly ranked. Epoch-5 five-sign result is retrospective. No live reliability claim.

removed_checkpoint_policy: All snapshots not explicitly retained; old bulk/dedicated archives removed and replaced by one curated-only backup.
